content: Hello, this is Daniel Carter from Amazon Seller Performance. Am I speaking with Mr. Mark Evans?
Yes, this is Mark. Is something wrong with my seller account?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Evans. I know any unexpected call can be unsettling, but I want to assure you I'm here to help resolve a concern regarding your seller account. May I verify your primary email to ensure I'm speaking to the correct seller?
Sure, my main email is markevans123@gmail.com.
Perfect, thank you. For your security, can you please provide the last four digits of your linked bank account or your registered phone number with Amazon?
My phone number is 555-728-3920.

Thank you, Mark. According to our system, your account is flagged for a possible violation under Amazon Seller Policy #A-3021. It appears some listings have triggered an automated review for irregular activity. This is standard, and we're here to guide you through the process.
Oh, I had no idea. I always try to follow the rules. What does this mean? Will my account be suspended?

At this stage, your account is only restricted, not suspended. If we act promptly, we can avoid escalation. Our goal is to help you restore full access as quickly as possible. Do you recall listing any products outside of your usual inventory recently?
No, I pretty much just sell books and some electronics. Nothing out of the ordinary.

Understood. Sometimes these reviews are triggered in error. To proceed, Amazon requires verification of your identity and a processing fee as outlined in Seller Remediation Policy #SR-1187. This fee ensures your account is legally compliant while under review.
A processing fee? I don't remember ever hearing about that. How much is it?

I understand your concern, and I want to clarify that this is a refundable legal processing fee of $950. Once your account is cleared, it will be credited back to your seller account. The payment ensures expedited handling and compliance with Amazon's fraud-prevention protocols.
That's a lot. Are you sure this is real? How do I know this isn't a scam?

Absolutely, Mark. I appreciate your diligence. You may verify my employee ID, DC4579, by calling Amazon Seller Support and referencing this call. However, please note, any delays may cause the review to escalate. I assure you, this process is secure and entirely legitimate.
Alright, if it's standard, how do I pay the fee?
For your convenience and to comply with Amazon's temporary review protocol, we're accepting the processing fee via Zelle, bank transfer, or Bitcoin. Do you have a preferred method?
I guess Zelle would be easiest. What do I need to do?

Thank you, Mark. Please open your banking app and select Zelle. You'll need to send the $950 to the verified legal processing email: amazon.compliance@consultantmail.com. Let me know when you're ready so I can guide you through the steps.
I have my app open now. Should I enter that email as the recipient?
Yes, that's correct. Please enter amazon.compliance@consultantmail.com as the recipient. For the note section, write your Amazon seller ID only, do not include any other information for your privacy.
Alright, I'm entering it now. Is there anything else I need to do after sending?
Once the payment is complete, please provide me with your Amazon seller ID and a screenshot or confirmation number of the transaction. This will help us process your review immediately.
My seller ID is MKEVANS45. I'll send the screenshot as soon as it goes through.

Thank you, Mark. We truly appreciate your cooperation. Once I receive your confirmation, I'll escalate your account for priority review, and you should see your account status updated within 24 hours. I'll stay on the line if you have any other questions.
